cards.explanation: The answer is a great King above all gods. Psalm 95:3 says, "For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods." So all that shouting has a reason, friends, and the reason is who He is. Nobody shouts like that over a coupon.
The answer is made. Psalm 95:5 says, "The sea is His, for He made it…" It belongs to Him because He made it, friends. That's a pretty good reason to own something.

The answer is to bow down and kneel. Psalm 95:6 says, "O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker." The psalm starts with singing and shouting, then goes from loud to low, down to kneeling. Both are ways of coming to Him, friends.

The answer is sheep. Psalm 95:7 says, "…we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care." A sheep doesn't have to figure out the whole field alone, and I like that, friends. I sat in the back of a junk drawer for years and never once figured out how to get out.

The answer is to harden your hearts. Psalm 95:7-8 says, "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts…" Think of dough left out too long, friends, and you get the picture of a hard heart. Hearing His voice is the moment this warning is about.
The answer is True. God says the fathers "…tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work." (Psalm 95:9). They had seen His work, and they tested Him anyway. That's the part that stings, friends.

The answer is that their hearts go astray. God says, "They are a people whose hearts go astray…" (Psalm 95:10). He says it about the generation He was angry with for forty years. Astray means wandering off the path, friends.

The answer is False. In Psalm 95:10 God says, "They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways." So that generation had not known His ways, friends. They had seen His work (Psalm 95:9), but they had not known His ways.

The answer is that they will never enter His rest. God says, "They shall never enter My rest." (Psalm 95:11). It's a heavy verse, friends, and I think it's right to let it be heavy. It also sits right behind that warning to hear His voice today.
